WORK POST LAWS & BOUNDARIES

  • 25-METER SPHERICAL OPERATING POST Each role is bounded to a 25m radius sphere centered on its Work Post totem. Workers evaluate resources, benches, and storage exclusively inside this territory.
  • TOOL TIER VS MATERIAL HARDNESS Workers automatically scan local containers and their inventory for required tool tiers (e.g., Bronze Pickaxe for Iron, Fine Bow for needle arrows).
  • 10% DURABILITY REPAIR CYCLE When equipped tool health drops below 10%, the worker immediately halts extraction and navigates to the nearest Forge or Workbench for instant restoration.
  • SHELTER, REST & COMFORT DYNAMICS Workers assigned to covered beds gain stamina regeneration buffs and sleep through stormy nights, resuming labor at sunrise.

CONTAINER ROUTING SYNTAX [TAGS]

  • [WOOD] & [FINEWOOD] Lumberjacks deposit chopped round logs, core wood, and fine wood into designated chests.
  • [ORE], [COAL] & [STONE] Miners dump raw ores and stone chunks; Smelters pull fuel and charge hoppers automatically.
  • [PRODUCE], [SEED] & [MEAT] Farmers sort vegetables into larders and seeds into planting bins; Ranchers route cuts to cold store.
  • [INGOT] & [TOOLS] Foundrymen store refined bars; Craftsmen pull metals to maintain citadel fortresses.

PART I: THE LUMBERJACK (FORESTER & ARBORIST)

FORESTRY • TIMBER

AUTONOMOUS AI WORK-CYCLE

  • 1. ARBORIST PROSPECTING: Surveys the 25m station boundary, validating equipped axe tier against wood hardness (Birch/Oak need Bronze+).
  • 2. DIRECTIONAL TREE FELLING: Strikes trunks at ergonomic angles to fell timber into open ground, preventing collateral damage to base roofs.
  • 3. LOG BUCKING & STUMP CLEARING: Bucks fallen trunks into portable timber chunks and thoroughly excises tree stumps to clear ground.
  • 4. NURSERY REPLANTING GRID: Deploys Beech seeds, Birch seeds, and Fir cones at 3m spacing to establish perpetual sustainable harvest groves.

HUGIN'S ADVICE & QUIRKS

  • STUMP INTEGRITY: Stumps never regrow. Workers ensure 100% stump clearing so new saplings can be rooted on flat ground.
  • LOG COLLISION DEFENSE: Felling massive trees near buildings can damage timber beams; workers path around walls before cutting.
  • AXE TIER VALIDATION: Stone axes cannot fell Fine Wood (Birch/Oak). Equip at least a Bronze Axe for advanced biomes.

ACTIVE DOMAIN CAPABILITIES

  • [F01] PRECISION TREE FELLING: Shatters Beech, Birch, Fir, Pine, and Oak trunks using appropriate tool tiers.
  • [F02] TIMBER LOG BUCKING: Splits downed logs into regular Wood, Core Wood, and Fine Wood bundles.
  • [F03] STUMP REMOVAL PASS: Chops underground stump colliders clean from soil to maximize settlement building area.
  • [F04] AUTOMATED ARBOR NURSERY: Re-plants tree seeds in aligned grid patterns to regenerate timber supply within the base.
  • [F05] 50X WOOD STACK OVERFLOW: Constructs 50x wood_pile structures automatically when settlement storage boxes are full.

SETTLEMENT DOMAIN SYNERGY

  • SMELTER CHARCOAL PIPELINE: Feeds continuous timber stacks directly to Kilns for unlimited smelting fuel.
  • CRAFTSMAN TIMBER DEPOT: Delivers structural Core Wood and Fine Wood directly to the Carpenter for citadel defense.
  • HAULER WAGON TRANSFER: Drops heavy lumber stacks into parked wagons for mass player transit.

TACTICAL AI TROUBLESHOOTING

  • WORKER STUCK IN PLACE (PATHING DEADLOCK) Use a Hoe to smooth abrupt cliff edges. Ensure doorways are at least 2m wide and stairs have no steep obstructions.
  • WORKER IDLE ("NO WORK AVAILABLE") Confirm target nodes (rocks, crops, trees) are within the 25m sphere and required tool tiers are available in chests.
  • CONTAINER FULL DEADLOCK Workers halt extraction if matching chests are full. Enable 50x resource piles or add extra chests tagged with [Tag].
  • WORKBENCH LEVEL INSUFFICIENT High-tier tool repairs require upgraded station levels. Place Anvils, Coolers, and Chopping Blocks nearby.

HUGIN'S GOLDEN RULES OF BASE DESIGN

  • CENTRAL LOGISTICS HUB Place Hauler depots in the geographic center of your base to minimize transfer distance between quadrants.
  • RAMPED ROADWAYS Pave dirt roads into flat stone or leveled soil paths; carts move 40% faster and rarely lose traction on ramps.
  • OVERLAPPING WATCHTOWERS Build guard towers at perimeter corners so Sentry bow sightlines intersect, eliminating all dead zones.

CONFIGURATION MATRIX (valheimworkers.cfg)

  • ScanIntervalSeconds = 2.5 Evaluation tick frequency in seconds. Lower values increase responsiveness; higher values optimize potato CPUs.
  • MaxWorkersPerZone = 12 Caps total concurrent autonomous workers permitted inside a single active 64m world zone to protect server FPS.
  • PathingMeshDetail = High Controls navmesh resolution around player structures, doors, and complex terrain modifications.
  • AutoDepositOverflow = True Allows Lumberjacks and Miners to erect physical 50x wood and stone piles when storage boxes are capped.
  • ToolDurabilityThreshold = 0.10 Percentage (10%) at which workers disengage from tasks to seek repair at a Workbench or Forge.

CONSOLE COMMANDS (F5)

  • worker_debug on/off Toggles visual debug rendering of the 25m operating sphere, task raycasts, and pathing nodes.
  • worker_reset Forces all nearby workers to drop current tasks, re-scan inventory, and re-bind to valid work posts.
  • worker_status Prints a full diagnostic report of nearby worker inventories, stamina, and current AI states to the console.
